newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Anhui Expressway debuts at HK$1.77.
newsitem.headline: Anhui Expressway debuts at HK$1.77.

text.p: Shares of China toll road operator Anhui Expressway Co Ltd made their trading debut at HK$1.77 per share in Hong Kong, unchanged from the issue price.
The shares fell to HK$1.59 within minutes of the market opening.
Anhui Expressway is the 22nd Chinese enterprise to list H-shares in Hong Kong. H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese companies listed in Hong Kong.

The toll road operator offered a total 493.01 million H-shares at HK$1.77 per share, of which 73.95 million made up its initial public offering (IPO) in Hong Kong. The Hong Kong IPO was 1.04 times subscribed.
Anhui Expressway owns, operates and develops toll roads in China's inner Anhui province. It currently owns and operates the 134-km Hening (Nefei-Nanjing) Expressway.
